passives.name: Reinforced Armor
passives.effects: Turret basic attacks are modified to deal 14% – 8% (based on turret type) of this minion's maximum health as pre-mitigation damage.

passives.name: Minion Slayer
passives.effects: Against lane minions, this minion deals bonus physical damage on-hit equal to 6% of the target's current health.
